# DSH Workspace Explorer (dsh-workspace-explorer)
English | 中文
> Flip the DSH left sidebar to **Files** and see what is actually in your workspace — then drag a fi
le into the chat so DSH knows exactly what to read or edit.
## Why
While DSH is working, the workspace is a black box:
- The sidebar only lists conversations — **you can't see which files and folders the workspace holds

**.
- To point DSH at a file you type its path from memory, or first ask DSH to `ls` around.
- Mid-t
ask, checking what was just generated or changed means switching to a separate file manager.
**Workspace Explorer** puts the workspace right in the left sidebar. Browse files while a task runs,
find the one you need, **drag it into the composer**, and DSH can read or modify it immediately — n
o path typing, no window switching.
## Features
- **Chats | Files switch in the left sidebar** — a compact segmented control next to the *Workspace*
header. *Files* swaps the session list for the current session's workspace tree; *Chats* brings the

list back. The last view is remembered.
- **Lazy file tree** — folders load only when expanded, so

large workspaces stay fast. Filter expanded entries, collapse all, reload.
- **Drag to reference** —
drop a file or folder on the conversation area and an `@path` reference is inserted into the compos
er (`@"path"` when it contains spaces; folders end with `/`). After sending, DSH reads it by path —

or edits it if you ask.
- **One-click insert** — hover a row and click ⤶ to insert the same referenc

e.
- **Click to preview** — click a file to open DSH's built-in preview in the right sidebar.
- **Ri
ght-click menu** — right-click a file for *Open containing folder* (reveals and selects it in Explor
er / Finder), or a folder for *Show in file manager*. The menu also offers Preview, Insert into the

composer, and Copy full / relative path. The Menu key or Shift+F10 opens it from the keyboard.
- **G
it status, VS Code style** — names are colored by their state relative to the last commit, with a le
tter on the right: `M` modified (yellow), `U` untracked / `A` added (green), `D` deleted (red strike
-through, kept in place), `!` merge conflict; entries ignored by .gitignore are dimmed; folders with
changes inside get a dot. If the workspace itself is not a repository, repositories one level down
are picked up, like VS Code. Updates every 5 s, on window focus, and on Reload. Only a read-only `gi

t status` runs — the repository is never modified.
- **Right-sidebar view (optional)** — the right s
idebar's guide also offers *Workspace explorer* with the same tree, handy on wide screens.
## Usage
1. **Open the file view** — in the left sidebar, click **📁 Files** in the switch beside the *Workspa

ce* header.
2. **Find the file** — expand folders; with many entries, type in the filter box to narr

ow the expanded ones.
3. **Hand it to DSH** —
- **drag** the file/folder onto the conversation area

(release when the dashed hint appears), or
- hover the row and click **⤶**.

4. **Back to chats** — click **💬 Chats** in the switch.
> The tree shows the workspace of the **currently open session**; with no session open it asks you t
the workspace of the **currently open session**; with no session open it asks you to open one first.
## Install
**DSH Desktop**: install from **Settings → Plugins** inside the app (or one click from the dshmarket

Reload the DSH page (Ctrl+F5) afterwards to see the switch in the left sidebar.
## Compatibility and known limitations

- Tested on DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** (Web GUI / Desktop).
- DSH has no official extension seat in the left
-sidebar *Workspace* header yet, so the plugin locates its insertion point from the current sidebar
layout. If a DSH update changes that layout, the switch may fall back to the sidebar footer; please

open an issue with your DSH version.
- The switch is hidden while the left sidebar is collapsed to a

rail.
- Dragging inserts a **text reference** (`@path`); DSH reads the file on demand after you sen

d — nothing is uploaded as an attachment.
- Only files inside the current session's workspace can be

browsed.
- *Open containing folder* reuses DSH's built-in "Show file location" capability, so it wo
rks only when DSH runs on your own desktop; over a remote Web GUI the item is disabled.
## Privacy
The plugin lists directories through DSH's own workspace-files API only. It does not read file conte
nts, make network requests, or collect any data.
